thread:
yuki: Starting thread — hitting weird perf regression on Qwen2.5 after kernel selector change. p99 jumped from 120ms to 270ms on small request mix.

alex: oof. when did the selector change land?

yuki: yesterday 02:14 deploy, changed preferred kernel to fast-matmul-v2 for head dim 64. diff attached:
```diff
- prefer_kernel: matmul-default
+ prefer_kernel: fast-matmul-v2
``` 

sam: can you paste the perf profile /top? sounds like KV cache thrashing

perf-bot: profile summary for run 2025-08-12T14:02Z: total tokens 1.2M, avg latency 85ms -> 163ms, p99 120ms -> 270ms, kernel time +2.3x for attention_kv_update

dina: i dumped KV cache shapes during the run. noticed alternating kv.size = [batch, heads, seq, head_dim] that sometimes had head_dim 64 and sometimes 128 for the same model instance.

yuki: that matches my repro. tokenizer splitting of CJK sequences is creating variable rope scale offsets, which trips our alibi-vs-rope path and we end up swapping kernel implementations mid-request.

alex: swapping kernels mid-request is bad, we don't preserve cached offsets. can we force a single kernel path for now?

sam: quick mitigation: runtime flag disable-kernel-hot-swap=true

yuki: patched flag and re-ran: p99 down to 135ms, avg 95ms. not ideal but stabilizes. putting a longer fix on my plate: normalize rope-scaled position ids in tokenizer for Qwen2.5 when multilingual mode enabled.

dina: also saw mismatched attention vs kv-head dims. some model configs had attention_heads=32 kv_head_dim=64 causing runtime to select head-splitting kernel. we should add a sanity check at model load and convert configs or emit warning.

infra-bot: filed issue INF-427: "Qwen2.5 tokenization/rope scaling -> kernel chooser instability" assigned to @yuki, priority P1.

yuki: will follow-up with a patch to: 1) normalize tokenizer offsets, 2) add model-config schema validation, 3) prevent kernel hot-swap within a single request. ETA end of week.

alex: thanks. can we capture a smoke test + perf regression eval in CI? add to INF-427.

sam: added a small perf probe (qwen2p5/rope/alibi/smoke) to canary. rolling now :thumbsup:

perf-bot: canary results incoming in ~20m.
